# Implementation Plan: Show Multipliers & Scoring Completeness

**Branch**: `003-show-multipliers-scoring` | **Date**: 2026-06-23 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/003-show-multipliers-scoring/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Makes card strategy and group chemistry meaningful by seeding per-show multiplier templates, wiring the scheduler to copy them into every new show at creation time, adding an always-on logarithmic chemistry bonus (with a live lineup preview), fixing tie ranking so equal scores share a rank, and surfacing the day's multiplier category labels on the lineup page. No new npm packages; one new DB table; all changes are additive to the existing schema and scoring pipeline.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 20 (backend), React 18 + Vite (frontend)

**Primary Dependencies**: express 5, pg, node-cron, React — no new packages required

**Storage**: PostgreSQL via `pg` pool; all schema changes additive (one new table)

**Testing**: No automated test framework. Validation via `quickstart.md` manual scenarios.

**Target Platform**: Linux server (API) + browser (React SPA)

**Project Type**: Web application (Express REST API + React SPA)

**Performance Goals**: No specific latency targets; scoring runs at show resolution (background cron), not on hot request path.

**Constraints**: No new npm dependencies. All schema changes must be additive (no drops, no column renames on existing tables). Seed scripts must be idempotent.

**Scale/Scope**: Small player base (test phase). Chemistry computation is O(lineup size) and runs at resolution time — no performance concern.
